name: ElasticPressButton
description: Physically inspired press deformation button with spring recovery, configurable squash scale, elasticity, border treatment, loading spinner state, and disabled state.
a11yNotes: Sets aria-busy={loading} and disabled={disabled || loading} to prevent duplicate form submissions and announces state changes to screen readers.

propsApi.name: loading
propsApi.description: Displays an inline spinner and sets aria-busy.
